report:
Skin, left shin, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. Small vessels in the superficial dermis show fibrinoid necrosis and neutrophils within their walls, with leukocytoclasia, extravasated red cells and eosinophils. The overall features are those of a leukocytoclastic vasculitis. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, left shin, punch biopsy - LEUKOCYTOCLASTIC VASCULITIS (please see description)
